_note: Preregistered. Written before any scoring existed. Both schemas are taken from their own sources, not invented for this benchmark: A from agent-framework core vocabularies, B from CONSTITUTION.md section 1. The binding table is authored by the benchmark author and is this instrument's primary limitation; see CLM-0001.md.

schema_A_agent_centric.source: agent framework core vocabularies (agent, tool, prompt, memory, plan, run, message)

schema_B_work_centric.source: CONSTITUTION.md section 1 chain: Work, Opportunity, Automation Decision, Engineering, Control, Execution, Evidence, Evaluation, Outcome

_binding_rule: BOUND = a core slot holds the concept without being redefined. ESCAPE = representable only by importing a runtime- or platform-specific concept into the core, which BENCH-0001 counts as a boundary violation. The same criterion is applied to both schemas.
